areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Limited adherence: road-centred objective; urban crossings and active-mobility actions are isolated and take a marginal resource share.

areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: Road-safety actions relate only indirectly to integrated citizen public safety; low resource share and low impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Climate-resilient road maintenance, institutional strengthening and a climate-response indicator give adherence; viable targets, relevant impact, efficient and innovative solutions.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Road improvements create favourable structural conditions (lower logistics costs), but no targets or indicators tied to productivity or competitiveness.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Low adherence: only indirect, temporary jobs and restricted training of vulnerable groups; no structured employability policy or employment indicators.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Indirect effects via pilgrim routes and a cycle path; tiny resource share and indicators measure transport rather than tourism value added.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Road-sector programme with no direct link to women's protection; one workforce-inclusion indicator is isolated, with no dedicated resources or structural policy.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Only a coastal cycle-path design component with marginal resources; no structured policy promoting sport or physical activity.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: General objective not tied to regional-inequality outcomes; rural-road product has a weak link and no dedicated resources.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Improvement is sectoral (road management and performance contracts), not broad state-capacity strengthening; indicators and resources are not aligned.
